title: Add a data-oriented Intermittent Fasting dashboard section

requirements.text: Add a data-oriented Intermittent Fasting detail view that appears on the dashboard when the “Intermittent Fasting” factor is selected, emphasizing quantitative metrics and structured data (KPIs, timelines, and summaries) rather than a minimal/abstract presentation.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user selects the fasting factor marker, a fasting-focused panel/section becomes visible in the dashboard.

The fasting panel uses a clearly data-forward layout (e.g., KPI tiles, small tables/lists, and timeline-style blocks) and uses legible numeric typography (e.g., monospace for time/metrics) consistent with the existing dark theme.
The fasting panel can be dismissed/hidden by de-selecting the fasting marker (clicking it again), consistent with the current selectedFactor toggle behavior.

requirements.text: Implement the Intermittent Fasting panel contents to include: (1) a current status block (Fasting / Eating Window / Starts In…), (2) a timer-style time readout for time remaining or time elapsed, (3) a progress indicator for the current window, (4) a daily + weekly summary (e.g., fasting sessions count, total fasting hours), (5) a streak metric, and (6) a small “insights/tips” area based on the current phase; all user-facing strings must be in English (and German when DE is selected) using the existing i18n structure.
acceptanceCriteria: The fasting panel shows all six content groups (status, timer, progress, daily/weekly summary, streak, insights/tips).
The timer readout updates while visible (at least once per second) and remains performant (no UI jank).
Daily/weekly stats and streak are displayed as numeric values in a consistent unit format.
All new labels/messages in the fasting panel are translated via the existing translations dictionary and switch correctly with the language toggle.

requirements.text: Ensure the fasting panel integrates cleanly into the existing StartDashboard layout with responsive behavior (mobile through desktop), without obscuring the helix visuals or breaking existing factor marker interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: On small screens, the fasting panel content remains readable without horizontal overflow and stacks appropriately.
On larger screens, the fasting panel does not overlap the factor marker cards; spacing and z-indexing keep the helix/markers usable.
All existing factor markers remain clickable and keyboard-accessible as before.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing components instead).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep all user-facing text in English in EN mode and German in DE mode via the existing i18n mechanism.
nonGoals: Persisting fasting schedules/logs to the Motoko backend.
Adding notifications, reminders, push, email, or SMS features.
Integrating external health APIs or device data.
